verification.wholeOwnerRead: All 1227 input lines freshly read in ranges 1–310, 311–620, 621–930 and 931–EOF. The first combined middle output was truncated; both complete middle ranges were read again separately. The 1383-line final file adds only dates, 31 metadata terms/anchors and nine alt aliases. An exact-content test proves its explanatory body, code, equations, captions and source links are unchanged after removing those bounded navigation additions; no new full final reread is claimed.
verification.explanation: Existing source-faithful derivations retained: exact LLaMA matrix/state counts; separate dX/dW; 6P exclusions and context-length costs; checkpointing and MFU/HFU; ring bytes; FSDP transient weights; TP partition shapes; separate/shared network budgets; TP/EP assignments and traffic; Qwen3/DeepSeek block counts; pipeline dependencies and schedules. No short synthetic replacement or translation.
verification.source: The 2026-10-23 accepted chapter hash exactly matches this pass's input, so its bounded source-comparison evidence remains applicable to the unchanged body. That full audit and the visual-redesign/Harvard-link audits were read. Fresh selected CS336 lecture_02.py MFU (310–355) and gradients_flops (502–556), plus complete physical Assignment 2 pages 40–46 (§8.1–8.5), were read and compared. Current JAX/HF/source URLs checked. No new whole-course or fresh upstream pixel audit.
verification.preservation: Three-file reversible journal restores exact accepted hash 2d49342e… and both preceding indexes. All original prose, one NumPy program, 29 display equations, nine image paths/bytes and complete captions retained. No new image, generation, redraw or translation. Both indexes now expose 31 actual subjects of this same owner.
verification.style: no-ai-slop SKILL and eval read fully. Existing concrete explanations retained rather than rewritten for uniformity. Added subject labels and descriptive alts only; chapter status remains draft.

examples.scope: Actual NumPy program, eight finite differences, parameter/memory/collective arithmetic, MFU/HFU, 256 communication grids and 16 continuous-optimum controls passed on CPU. Not a GPU/distributed timing experiment.

tests.scope: Current arithmetic preservation and 31 subjects, preceding roofline journal chain, both index synchronization and all current built-output tests.

visual.desktop: 1280×900: document 1265/1265, 617px content, all 29 display equations fit and zero KaTeX errors. All nine original figures/captions personally inspected whole in the image viewer: JAX block, HF memory, NeMo checkpointing, both FSDP passes, EDLS TP/EP and GPipe/1F1B.
visual.mobile: 375×812: document 360/360, 328px content; all nine images load and have 328px-or-less displayed widths; all 29 display equations fit. Four inherited tables have internal scroll widths 354, 343, 336 and 423px, without expanding the document. FSDP surrounding explanation inspected; original vector viewer inspected at 2× with horizontal panning required. Temporary viewport reset.
visual.navigation: Actual EN reference FSDP term -> exact EN anchor, explicit canonical-language notice, Next -> EN mixed-precision H1. Actual RU reference traffic term -> exact TP/EP traffic anchor and visible section heading. All 31 destinations per locale checked by tests.

remaining: This is a whole-owner reading and navigation pass, not a claim that all course material is integrated or that every chapter is accepted.
Existing Zero Bubble/DualPipe schedules remain primary-source links, not newly reproduced figures. Historical figure provenance/pixel evidence is reused, not freshly upgraded.

Whole-book release checks and dev/Pages publication remain pending.
